brand.name: Tallow Row
brand.descriptor: A small fashion label making natural-fibre workwear in short seasonal runs.

text.heading: Workwear cut from undyed cotton canvas
text.body: Tallow Row makes a short seasonal run of jackets, trousers and shirting in natural-fibre cloth, made in Portland, Oregon.

text.heading: This season's anchor piece
text.name: The Field Jacket, undyed canvas
text.description: A four-pocket, unlined canvas jacket with brass hardware. Made in Portland, Oregon.

text.heading: The rest of the autumn run
Buy from the autumn run
text.body: Everything is live on our shop while stock lasts. No preorder needed this season.

text.heading: Shipping and returns
text.body: Orders ship within three business days. Unworn pieces with tags attached can be returned within thirty days for a refund.

items.quote: Wore the field jacket through a wet Portland winter and it only got better with age.
The canvas is heavier than I expected in a good way, and the stitching is clean.

text.heading: A small workshop, not a factory
text.body: Tallow Row started as two sewists cutting patterns on a kitchen table. We still cut and sew every piece ourselves, in runs small enough to know where each bolt of cloth came from.

text.tagline: Natural-fibre workwear, sewn in small seasonal runs.
